description: 서울교통공사_지하역사 공기질 측정 정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 서울교통공사. 서울교통공사에서 운영하는 지하역사의 실내 공기질 측정 정보를 제공하는 공공데이터입니다. 본 자료는 「실내공기질관리법」에 따른 유지기준 관리 항목을 대상으로 정기적으로 측정된 결과를 포함하고 있으며, 미세먼지(PM10), 초미세먼지(PM2. 5), 이산화탄소, 일산화탄소, 폼알데하이드, 이산화질소, 라돈... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 서울교통공사. Its tags are 지하철역, 공기질, 공기질측정, 지하철 환경정보, 대기오염물질 농도. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
